native_capture.contents: Lossless exact requests, raw responses, refusals, timings, runtime metadata, inputs/config/code fingerprints and accepted candidate proposals, including all intermediate semantic failures. No weights or native binaries.

scoring.method: Agent inspection against the frozen committed source excerpts, not another model or exact-text matching. Machine completion is required for task success but does not prove semantic/localization quality.
scoring.split_caveat: The original four were development cases. Six expansion inputs were predeclared but subsequently inspected during development, so are no longer untouched. Four fresh reserve inputs first ran after protocol selection; their failures did not drive prompt/model tuning. Reverification is not an independent trial.
scoring.global_bounds: Platform, severity/criticality and complexity are deliberately unknown by construction; these runs do not evaluate reliable extraction of known values. No source establishes a new canonical fact.
scoring.draft_review: Base64 and OK-variable prose preserves the inspected behavior/input scope, but still needs human review in all five languages. Spanish Base64 has 'el entrada'; French OK has 'lorsqu'exécutent ces commandes' and Japanese OK uses awkward 'further changed' phrasing. Do not equate complete proposals with publication-ready translations.
scoring.duplicate: Material-delta repeats Base64 content and is a delta-routing case, not an independent generative-quality success.

cases.name: base64
cases.assessment: Behavior-change, 18 R4, invalid single-BLOB scope and no documented remedy match evidence. Five locales/25 fields, official French alias; awkward Spanish grammar still requires review.

cases.name: unknown
cases.assessment: Behavior-change and unknown release/remedy are now correct. English correctly describes empty text/blob for invalid toDecode. Japanese title retains Invalid on both attempts; no complete localization or patch.

cases.name: insufficient
cases.assessment: Correct insufficient decision on a generic introduction; all metadata unknown, no prose/patch. Previously incorrectly drafted.

cases.name: listbox
cases.assessment: Extraction correctly identifies optional documented action and unknown release. English still says handler must verify editing state, contradicting optional evidence; action is literally optional and rationale E1 instead of useful prose. Numeric-reference refusal is not an entailment check or a correct semantic decision.

cases.name: french-restriction
cases.assessment: Restriction and explicit 19 R4 now recognized. Japanese translates ternary operator as 3項演算子; the strict numeric heuristic rejects 3 absent as a source digit. This is a validator false positive, not evidence of an unsupported threshold/model semantic error; no completed proposal.

cases.name: japanese-events
cases.assessment: Behavior-change/18 R6 extraction correct; English authoring echoes Japanese on both attempts. Explicit English script refusal now catches the actual localization failure. Earlier selected run instead stopped downstream on a German title length rule; neither is a quality pass.

cases.name: optional-not-mandatory
cases.assessment: Correct insufficient decision: replacement-not-required alone is no new change. Previously incorrectly drafted.

cases.name: undated-deprecation
cases.assessment: Deprecation, unknown release/remedy are appropriate. English is awkward/incomplete; German title copies English on both attempts. No full five-locale draft.

cases.name: irrelevant-context
cases.assessment: Correct insufficient decision; rhetorical lead-in alone produces no prose/patch.

cases.name: material-delta
cases.assessment: Correct material_change routing and bounded draft. Localization bodies are identical to Base64, so not an independent semantic success.

cases.name: ok-variable
cases.assessment: Behavior-change/18 R4, commands no longer setting OK, no invented command identity or remedy. Five locales/25 fields; French/German/Japanese phrasing needs editorial review.

cases.name: french-pdf-deprecation
cases.assessment: Wrong restriction type (expected deprecation), false unknown cutoff (missed à partir de 4D v20), and English says no longer supports/replaced instead of deprecated. Wrong-locale constant alias is the observed guard refusal, not verification of those semantic errors.

cases.name: empty-aggregate-results
cases.assessment: Correct behavior-change and empty-selection Undefined versus prior Null meaning; false unknown cutoff because prior to v18 R6 is not recognized. Paragraph omits exact entitySelection identifier despite correct title; contract refusal, not proof functional summary is false.

cases.name: recommendation-only
cases.assessment: Correct insufficient decision on advice without a changed fact; no prose/patch.

unselected_development.note: The earlier combined-English/separate-title-body protocol performed best on inspected development cases. Intermediate focused-action/native-locale variants were not shipped. All generated failures and exact prompts/configs remain in the native archive.

sampling_experiment.note: Upstream-recommended sampling did not improve original-four outcomes. Base64 retained When in Japanese, unknown retained Invalid, insufficient was correct, list-box failed Spanish translation. Not used on reserve for tuning.

bounded_precision_experiment.note: Same instruction model/revision, one higher-precision alternative. No observed development-case completion gain over decomposed Q4; still untranslated Japanese and event-generation distortion. Q4 retained for smaller resource footprint. This experiment predates the final token-list/native-locale prompt correction and is not a head-to-head final-pipeline quality benchmark.
